metadata.title: Cloud Monitoring and Logging

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability ensuring cloud activity, configuration changes, and security-relevant events are observable, auditable, and retained.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Cloud logging services, telemetry pipelines, audit logs, and monitoring systems across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Establishes consistent observability, logging, and auditability across cloud service models.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Cloud monitoring and logging build on baseline cloud infrastructure trust assumptions.

metadata.remarks: Cloud Monitoring and Logging defines the trust properties required to ensure cloud activity and security-relevant events are observable and auditable. This pattern addresses a primary cloud risk: undetected misuse, misconfiguration, or compromise due to insufficient or unreliable telemetry.

components.title: Cloud Activity Logging
components.description: Recording of security-relevant actions within cloud infrastructure and services.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or modification of cloud audit logs to evade detection.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Generation of audit logs for cloud control-plane and workload actions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Define auditable events for cloud environments.
Generate audit records for cloud activities.

components.title: Cloud Telemetry and Alerting
components.description: Detection and signaling of anomalous or security-relevant cloud behavior.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Disabling or impairing cloud monitoring and alerting services.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Continuous collection and analysis of cloud telemetry.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Monitor cloud systems for indicators of compromise or misuse.
Ongoing monitoring of cloud security posture.

components.title: Log Retention and Integrity
components.description: Preservation of cloud logs with integrity sufficient for audit and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Tampering with stored logs to undermine investigations.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Protection of logs against deletion or modification.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protect audit information and log integrity.
